headline: Hilton (HLT) Raises Full Year Outlook As World Cup Demand Enters View
summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings (NYSE:HLT) raised its full year profit forecast. The company also increased its full year RevPAR outlook. Management linked the new guidance to strong demand trends and the expected impact of the upcoming FIFA World Cup. Hilton Worldwide Holdings operates a global portfolio of hotel brands, so its updated guidance gives you a fresh read on travel and lodging demand.
